name: Generating-Florida-AirBNBs-Insights
what_it_holds: A single Tableau packaged workbook ('AirBNB in Florida Insights.twbx', repo ~14MB) plus a README, pushed April 2022. Tableau .twbx files bundle an internal data extract (often Inside Airbnb-derived) but the raw rows are not directly exposed as CSV without opening in Tableau or unzipping the .twbx.
why_useful: Potentially an older (2022, pre-2023) Florida Airbnb listings snapshot, which would be valuable under gap #1 (historical/archived Inside Airbnb dumps), but the data is locked inside a proprietary Tableau extract format with no README detail on source date, city, or fields, making it low-confidence and low-accessibility.

name: keithah/hospitable-python
what_it_holds: MIT-licensed Python SDK (2 stars, updated 3 Nov 2025) for the Hospitable Public API v2. Covers vacation-rental properties, reservations, calendar, messaging, and reviews. Hospitable is a mid-size multi-channel PMS managing thousands of Airbnb/Vrbo/Booking.com listings; the API exposes per-reservation nightly rate, length of stay, channel, and property/market metadata to the account owner.
why_useful: Documents the field-level schema (ADR-equivalent nightly rate, LOS, channel/source, market) a professional multi-listing operator's system captures per booking — the same fields needed to build a bottom-up nights/ADR panel, if a cooperating Hospitable-using PM ever exported their own portfolio.
geography: wherever the connected account's listings are
size_hint: code only, no data (requires the operator's own API key)
themes: wildcard: an Airbnb superhost / small property manager who uses open-s
why_all: Documents the field-level schema (ADR-equivalent nightly rate, LOS, channel/source, market) a professional multi-listing operator's system captures per booking — the same fields needed to build a bottom-up nights/ADR panel, if a cooperating Hospitable-using PM ever exported their own portfolio.

name: timwoodland/hospitable_financial_exporter
what_it_holds: Small unlicensed Python script (updated 15 Jun 2026) written by an actual Hospitable-using host/PM to export their own financial data (per-listing revenue/booking detail) from Hospitable to CSV for a chosen date range.
why_useful: A real, in-the-wild example of a small property manager exporting exactly the revenue/occupancy fields (by listing, by date range) this project would want in bulk; useful chiefly as a schema reference / proof that hosts routinely build these exports themselves, not as a source of usable third-party data (single-account, no data committed).
